metadata.title: Transits Probabilities Around Hypervelocity and Runaway Stars

notes: No eligible individual star is identifiable. The paper analyzes generic hypervelocity/runaway-star populations and an unnamed “present sample of 20 HVSs” (T:p4-b3; T:p4-b6), plus literature samples of hypervelocity and runaway candidates (T:p7-b4; T:p8-b8), without giving individual stellar names or source identifiers. Kepler-11, Kepler-33, and GJ 876 (T:p2-b11) are cited only as examples of known compact planetary systems, not as Galactic unbound candidates.
